purpose: Resolve the minimum selector semantics required before any as-of DecisionEligibility policy selector can be implemented or connected to B-07e.

rationale: CandidateDecisionV1 has no native program_id/policy anchor.
B-05b already projects FieldProgramV1 into canonical Context with DECLARED_FIELD_PROGRAM.program_id.
Using legacy recommendation.program_id would backflow legacy provenance into canonical selection authority.
fail_closed: more than one matching DECLARED_FIELD_PROGRAM assertion
anchor type/ref does not exactly match declaration

rationale: EvidenceScopeV1 defines nullable values but no hierarchy/wildcard semantics.
Exact equality is fail-closed and does not invent hierarchy.
rejected: field-level policy automatically applies to all zones

rationale: Candidate.decision_time is the closest canonical causal boundary.
Fallback to evaluation or wall clock would change what policy was knowable at the candidate boundary.
No current authority defines composition or precedence.
Immutable predecessor facts cannot be edited to add effective_until.
A validated supersession pointer can provide append-only replacement semantics.
rejected: multiple live successors resolved by latest-wins

implementation_constraints_if_authorized: Selector must consume canonical CandidateDecisionV1, canonical ContextSnapshot, and persisted declaration facts.
Selector must not read legacy recommendation.program_id as authority.
Selector must not use wall clock to repair missing decision_time.
Selector must not silently rank or compose multiple policies.
Selector must preserve causal as-of filtering on both payload declared_at and persisted occurred_at.
Selector must return a selected policy object only after all scope/anchor/time/supersession checks pass.
B-07e may not be connected until at least one real product policy declaration is separately authorized and persisted.
exact_decision_text: Use canonical ContextSnapshot DECLARED_FIELD_PROGRAM as the v1 policy scope anchor; exactly one matching program assertion is required.
Use exact nullable EvidenceScope equality; null is not wildcard and no specificity/parent inheritance exists in v1.
Require non-null CandidateDecision.decision_time as the sole policy-selection boundary; no fallback clock is allowed.
Require declaration.declared_at and persisted fact.occurred_at to be <= decision_time.
If more than one applicable policy remains, fail closed; no latest/version/specificity precedence and no composition.

A valid supersedes_policy_ref deactivates its predecessor at successor.effective_from only when predecessor exists, is already known, shares policy_id, exact scope and exact anchor, and the chain is acyclic; ambiguous successors fail closed.
Action applicability remains exact string membership.
This decision does not authorize any actual policy content or B-07e connection.
